prompt:
Generate a single game sprite: An animation sprite sheet: exactly four frames side by side in one row of four equal cells, no \
gaps, no borders, no numbers. Every frame shows exactly the robot in the attached sprite, same size, same \
position in its cell, same chair, same camera angle and light; only its writing hand and pencil move, as a looping writing cycle, and its head nods slightly.

Style: match the attached reference crops from the concept art exactly. Soft, clean, slightly stylised 3D render of an isometric office, three-quarter view from above at the same camera angle as the references (about 30 degrees down). Warm soft key light from the upper left, gentle ambient occlusion, no harsh shadows. Pale, desaturated palette. Render only the object, centred, whole and uncropped, on a fully transparent background: no floor, no ground shadow, no backdrop, no text, no border.
instructions: You are a sprite generator. Always answer by calling the image_generation tool exactly once. Do not reply with text.
revised_prompt: Create a single transparent PNG game animation sprite sheet. Canvas contains exactly four equal-sized cells arranged side by side in one row, no gaps, no borders, no numbers, no text. In each cell, show the same cute white robot seated on the same black office chair, matching the attached reference: soft clean slightly stylised 3D render, isometric office character, three-quarter view from above at about 30 degrees down, warm soft key light from upper left, gentle ambient occlusion, pale desaturated palette. Robot has rounded glossy white body, black face screen with two glowing cyan eyes, grey joints, seated posture, holding paper/tablet on lap and writing with a yellow pencil. Transparent background only; no floor, no ground shadow, no backdrop. The robot is centered, whole, uncropped, same size and same position in every cell, same camera angle and lighting. Only animate as four-frame looping writing cycle: frame 1 pencil hand raised slightly at start of stroke and head neutral; frame 2 hand lower and pencil touching paper with head nodding slightly down; frame 3 hand moves across page to the right with pencil angled, head slightly further down; frame 4 hand returns upward/left for loop and head rises slightly. Keep chair and body fixed, only writing hand/pencil and subtle head nod change. Ensure exactly four frames, one row, equal cells, no seams, transparent background.
